## Goal

Which user outcome, defect, or bottleneck does this change address?

## Scope

What changed on purpose? What is out of scope?

## Deleted or avoided

What code, dependency, target, entitlement, or step was removed or avoided? If this adds complexity, why is it needed?

## Acceptance criteria

The observable conditions that define success.

## Evidence

The simplest reliable proof, with its kind: compiler, preview, Simulator, unit test, UI test, physical device, or TestFlight. A Simulator run is not device evidence. Do not add tests only to fill this section.

## Security and privacy

Changed permissions, entitlements, trust boundaries, external input, model output, secrets, SDKs, or collected data. Write `None` only after you considered them.

## Documentation

Which brief, flow, contract, workboard row, or gate changed? Write `None` only when the documents still describe reality.

## Rollback

An App Store binary cannot be rolled back. How is this disabled, fixed forward, or kept compatible with data the previous version wrote?
